headline.summary: Simon Willison 在 WeAreDevelopers 北美大会闭幕演讲中，按时间线梳理 2026 年 LLM 领域的关键趋势。文章附有演讲视频、注释幻灯片与笔记，适合快速回看今年模型、智能体与开发工具的重要变化。
headline.summary_en: Simon Willison's closing keynote at WeAreDevelopers World Congress North America ties together the key LLM trends of the past year in a chronological exploration of 2026. The post includes the video, annotated slides and notes, making it a useful recap of model, agent and developer-tool shifts so far. It is a structured review from a widely read developer commentator rather than a breaking-news report.
